forecast-period.text: A high pressure system, centred over Victoria, will continue extending a ridge across South Australia as it moves into the Tasman Sea on Saturday. A cold front is forecast to move across the Bight from overnight Saturday into Sunday, before moving across southeast SA during Sunday evening, with another high pressure system moving into the Bight behind the front.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Morning frost, possibly severe, about parts of the southeast, central parts of the Northern Agricultural Area, and the Pastoral districts. Maximum temperatures below average. North to northeasterly winds, tending north to northwesterly winds ahead of a south to southwesterly change moving over the southwest in the evening.
Dry. Variable winds across the southeast, tending northeast to southeasterly elsewhere.

Morning frost about the Riverland, Flinders and parts of the Pastoral districts. Isolated showers developing about the Eyre Peninsula during the morning and extending southeast across the Agricultural Areas from the afternoon. Maximum temperatures near to below average. West to northwesterly winds ahead of a west to southwesterly change in the west, extending across southeastern parts throughout the day. Winds shifting south to southeasterly winds in the west later.

Possible patchy morning frost about parts of the southern Pastoral districts and possible morning fog about the Agricultural Areas. Isolated showers about the southeast, clearing during the evening. Maximum temperatures near to below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds.

text.p: Possible patchy morning frost about parts of the southern Pastoral districts. Dry. Maximum temperatures near to below average. Northeast to southeasterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Tuesday: Less than 1 mm about the Northern Agricultural Area, with 1-5 mm possible in the Southern Agricultural Area. Isolated falls between 5 to 15 mm possible about windward facing coasts and ranges and in the South East.
